source.name: LGD districts (2024) via bharatlas
source.credit: Local Government Directory (lgdirectory.gov.in), distributed by bharatlas

join_key: properties.district_lgd_code (string) = district_lgd_code in monthly_metrics_2011_2024.csv and dim_district.csv
caveats: Dashboard-grade simplification, not for survey use.
Mostly Census-2011-era geometry with later updates; names in the source can be older than the dashboard names.
Each district ring is simplified separately, so tiny gaps can appear along shared borders at high zoom.
